journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: Daily journal: attendance and every lesson of the day. Only your own lesson column is editable.
journal.chooseHint: Columns come from the timetable. If a subject occurs twice a day, the second one is named "Mathematics 2".
journal.needClass: Select a class to open the journal.
journal.noClasses: No lessons assigned to you. Check the timetable. Being a homeroom teacher is not enough — only the subject teacher can grade.
journal.noLessons: No lessons for this class on this day. Pick another day.
journal.noStudents: No active students in this class.
journal.gridHint: Grade: 0–100. Attendance: K, SZ, SL, KCH. Click a cell to change a grade instantly.
journal.autoPresentHint: A student who receives a grade is marked present (K) automatically.
journal.readOnly: You have no lesson with this class on this day — the journal is read-only.
